mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_result_data_transmission_info ( request_tracking_id, transmission_code, transmission_msg, transmission_time, transmission_url, transmission_param, transmission_result_data, resp_ctrl_cmd_code, resp_ctrl_cmd_msg, resp_ctrl_cmd_time ) VALUES ( #{requestTrackingId}, #{transmissionCode}, #{transmissionMsg}, NOW(3), #{transmissionUrl}, #{transmissionParam}, #{transmissionResultData}, #{respCtrlCmdCode}, #{respCtrlCmdMsg}, NOW(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_result_data_transmission_info SET transmission_result_data = #{transmissionResultData}, resp_ctrl_cmd_code = #{respCtrlCmdCode}, resp_ctrl_cmd_msg = #{respCtrlCmdMsg}, resp_ctrl_cmd_time = NOW(3) WHERE transmission_id = #{transmissionId} AND request_tracking_id = #{requestTrackingId};
